author: Kevin Kelly
short: Lavalink v4 music playback and voice diagnostics using Wavelink 3.x.
description: Music playback, queues, volume controls, and voice diagnostics for Red using Lavalink v4 and Wavelink 3.x. A reachable Lavalink node is required during cog loading. The command group is audio, which conflicts with Red's bundled Audio cog.
install_msg: Read https://github.com/kevinwaynekelly/kevin-cogs/blob/main/audioplus/README.md before loading. On first load, AudioPlus connects to http://127.0.0.1:2333 with the default Lavalink password. Unload Red's bundled Audio cog first if it is loaded. Node setup is owner-only: [p]audio setnode <host> <port> <password> <secure>, then [p]audio connectnode. Use [p]help audio for commands.
end_user_data_statement: Stores global Lavalink connection settings in Red Config: host, port, password, TLS flag, and resume timeout. Does not persist user listening histories or playlists in its own Config. Playback state is maintained in memory and on the connected Lavalink node.
